info.name: Eventprac - Full E2E Automated Test Suite
info.description: End-to-end automated suite covering the entire Eventprac API. Run top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner. Steps are ordered: Health -> Auth -> Events -> Ownership -> Bookings -> Teardown -> ClearAll. NOTE: set the collection variable clearAllCode to your CLEAR_ALL_CODE from .env before running, or the final 'clear DB' step will fail. Create/Update Event use multipart form-data (not JSON).
